title: The Meeting Before the Meeting
title_ja: 会議の前の小さな会議
fact_notes: 人物、具体的な出来事・実験・記録は架空の教材例。実在の調査や統計の結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: A student committee was preparing a welcome event for new members of the school.
sentences.ja: 生徒委員会は新入生を歓迎する行事を準備していた。

sentences.en: At every planning meeting, the same three students usually made most of the suggestions.
sentences.ja: 毎回の企画会議ではいつも同じ3人が提案の大半を行っていた。

sentences.en: Their ideas were often useful, but the committee leader wanted to hear from everyone.
sentences.ja: 彼らの案は役立つことが多かったが、委員長は全員の意見を聞きたかった。

sentences.en: She invited the quieter members to speak, yet they rarely offered detailed opinions during meetings.
sentences.ja: 口数の少ない委員に発言を促したが、会議で具体的な意見を述べることはめったになかった。

sentences.en: One afternoon, she spoke privately with a member named Jun after the meeting ended.
sentences.ja: ある日の午後、会議後にジュンという委員と個別に話した。

sentences.en: He explained that he often needed more time to organize his thoughts before speaking.
sentences.ja: 彼は発言前に考えを整理する時間がもっと必要なことが多いと説明した。

sentences.en: By the time he had prepared a suggestion, the discussion had usually moved to another topic.
sentences.ja: 提案を準備できた頃には、議論はたいてい別の話題に移っていた。

sentences.en: The leader realized that an invitation to speak did not necessarily create an equal opportunity.
sentences.ja: 委員長は発言を促すだけでは必ずしも平等な機会が生まれないと気づいた。

sentences.en: Before the next meeting, she sent everyone a short list of questions about the welcome event.
sentences.ja: 次の会議前に、歓迎行事についての短い質問一覧を全員に送った。

sentences.en: Members could write their ideas on paper or discuss them with a partner in advance.
sentences.ja: 委員は事前に案を紙に書いたり、相手と話し合ったりできた。

sentences.en: At the meeting itself, the leader allowed two minutes of silent thinking before each major decision.
sentences.ja: 会議では重要な決定の前に2分間静かに考える時間を設けた。

sentences.en: She also collected written suggestions from members who preferred not to speak immediately.
sentences.ja: すぐに発言したくない委員からは書面で提案を集めた。

sentences.en: As a result, the committee received several ideas that had never appeared in earlier discussions.
sentences.ja: その結果、過去の議論では出なかった案をいくつか得られた。

sentences.en: Jun suggested a simple activity that would help new students remember each other's names.
sentences.ja: ジュンは新入生が互いの名前を覚えるのに役立つ簡単な活動を提案した。

sentences.en: The more talkative members continued to contribute, but they also had time to consider other proposals.
sentences.ja: よく話す委員も引き続き意見を出したが、ほかの提案を検討する時間も持てた。

sentences.en: The group eventually combined ideas from several different members into a single plan.
sentences.ja: グループは最終的に複数の委員の案を一つの計画にまとめた。

sentences.en: The leader learned that silence does not always mean an absence of ideas or interest.
sentences.ja: 委員長は沈黙が必ずしも考えや関心の欠如を意味しないと学んだ。

sentences.en: People may need different conditions in order to participate comfortably and effectively.
sentences.ja: 人によって安心して効果的に参加するために必要な条件は異なる場合がある。

sentences.en: A well-designed discussion makes room for those differences without treating anyone as less capable.
sentences.ja: うまく設計された議論では誰かの能力を低く見なすことなく、そうした違いを受け入れられる。

sentences.en: The committee's improvement began not with a louder invitation but with a better way to listen.
sentences.ja: 委員会の改善は、より強く発言を促すことではなく、より良い聞き方から始まった。

questions.explanation_ja: 新入生歓迎行事を準備した。

questions.prompt: What did Jun need before speaking?
options: A microphone with a louder sound.
More time to organize his thoughts.
A written invitation from his parents.
questions.explanation_ja: 考えを整理する時間が必要だった。

questions.prompt: Why was an invitation alone insufficient?
options: It prevented talkative members from speaking.
It made written suggestions against the rules.
It removed all topics from meetings.
It did not address the different time members needed to think.
questions.explanation_ja: 個人によって必要な準備時間が異なる。

questions.prompt: What did the leader send before the meeting?
questions.explanation_ja: 短い質問一覧を送った。

options: Only Jun was allowed to speak.
The leader read all answers aloud.
Members had two minutes for silent thinking.
The meeting stopped for an hour.
questions.explanation_ja: 静かに考える時間を2分設けた。

options: A plan to cancel the welcome event.
An activity to help students remember names.
questions.explanation_ja: 互いの名前を覚える活動を提案した。

questions.prompt: What happened to the talkative members?
options: They were excluded from all discussions.
They still contributed while considering others' ideas.
They no longer had any ideas.
They were required to leave the committee.
questions.explanation_ja: 参加を継続し、ほかの案を考える時間も得た。

questions.prompt: What does absence mean in context?

options: Changing discussion conditions can make participation more inclusive.
Quiet students should be forced to speak first.
Efficient groups should ignore differences among members.
questions.explanation_ja: 参加しやすい条件を整えることが重要。

grammar.focus: yet they rarely offered detailed opinions
grammar.explanation_ja: yetはここでは逆接の接続詞。

grammar.focus: By the time he had prepared a suggestion
grammar.explanation_ja: by the timeはある時点までにという意味。

grammar.focus: or discuss them with a partner
grammar.explanation_ja: orは二つの選択肢を示す。
in order toは目的を表す。

discourse.role_ja: 発言を促したことと実際の発言の少なさを対比。
考えがまとまる時点と議論の進行を関係づける。
発言の多い委員の参加と変化を示す。

paraphrases.source: She invited the quieter members to speak, yet they rarely offered detailed opinions during meetings.
paraphrases.rewrite: She invited the quieter members to speak, but they seldom shared specific ideas in the meetings.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 静かな委員の発言を促しても具体的な案がなかなか出なかった。

paraphrases.source: By the time he had prepared a suggestion, the discussion had usually moved to another topic.
paraphrases.rewrite: Before he was ready to offer an idea, the group had often begun discussing something else.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 案がまとまる前に次の話題へ移った。

paraphrases.source: Members could write their ideas on paper or discuss them with a partner in advance.
paraphrases.rewrite: Members could prepare their thoughts by writing them down or talking with another member beforehand.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 書くか相手と話すかして事前に準備できた。

paraphrases.source: People may need different conditions in order to participate comfortably and effectively.
paraphrases.rewrite: People may require different circumstances to take part with confidence and success.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 参加に必要な条件は人によって異なる。

cloze.explanation_ja: 発言前に考えを整理した。
沈黙は考えの欠如とは限らない。
